title: Grammy Awards
metaDescription: Plan your trip to Grammy Awards. Find out when, where and how to stay.

overview.about: The Grammy Awards are the music industry's most prestigious honours, presented by the Recording Academy each winter in Los Angeles. From Record of the Year to dozens of genre categories, a Grammy is the defining accolade in recorded music, and the ceremony doubles as one of the year's biggest live-music broadcasts.
overview.nextEvent: The next Grammy Awards are held in Los Angeles, centred on the Crypto.com Arena. The Recording Academy's voting members decide the winners, and the show mixes awards with headline performances from the biggest names in music.

@graph.description: The Grammy Awards are the Recording Academy's annual music awards, with winners chosen through the Academy's voting process. The 2027 ceremony is scheduled for 7 February 2027 at Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles, with nominations announced on 16 November 2026. The local archive keeps the ceremony readable as an awards history, not just a single red-carpet night.
